home.title: Introducing new voices in independent film, every month.
home.intro: Short and feature films are considered against the published eligibility and evaluation criteria before results are announced online.

sections.title: One cycle every month
body: Entries close on the 20th at 23:59 JST. Award results are scheduled for 12:00 JST on the last day of the month.
items: Submission
Eligibility check

sections.title: Short and feature divisions
body: Films up to and including 35 minutes enter the short division. Films longer than 35 minutes enter the feature division.
items: Up to five candidates per division
Nine award categories per division
Digital certificates for confirmed winners

sections.title: Submission Criteria
body: Each film is reviewed for eligibility and creative achievement against the published rules and award criteria.
items: Runtime, rights, and subtitle requirements are checked
Direction, writing, cinematography, and performance are considered by award
Award results are announced on the official website

sections.title: Every detail, considered
body: Direction, writing, cinematography, performance, and the other elements that shape each film are reviewed against the published criteria.

sections.title: Online announcements
body: Monthly results, award categories, and certificate verification information are published on the official website.

sections.title: In-person programme
body: If screenings or filmmaker gatherings are held, the venue and date will be announced on the official website once confirmed.

about.title: Introducing new independent filmmaking talent to the world every month.
about.intro: A monthly film award offering short- and feature-film creators a continuing opportunity for recognition and discovery.

sections.title: Purpose
body: We discover distinctive films and their creators, creating new opportunities to reach audiences through monthly award announcements.

sections.title: Selection principles
body: Every entry is reviewed against the published eligibility requirements and evaluation criteria.
items: Clear submission requirements
Evaluation of each film's creative achievement
Official online award announcements
Certificates and laurels for winners

sections.title: Film selection
body: After checking runtime, rights, subtitles, and other entry requirements, films are considered for direction, writing, cinematography, performance, production, and the other award criteria.

submit.title: Submit Your Film
submit.intro: Submissions are accepted through FilmFreeway. Please review the rules before submitting.

sections.title: Before you submit
body: Confirm runtime, rights, subtitle availability, contact details, and the applicable fee and refund policy.
items: Short: up to 35 min
Feature: over 35 min
The submitter must hold the rights required for review and any winner feature
Dialogue in languages other than English or Japanese requires English subtitles

sections.title: Submission route
body: Submit using the button at the top of this page.

sections.title: Fee and refunds
body: The submission fee is USD 40 per entry. Submission fees are non-refundable except when the event is cancelled by the organizer or due to a natural disaster.

sections.title: Monthly deadline
body: The monthly intake window runs from the 21st of the previous month through the 20th at 23:59 JST.

rules.title: Please review these rules before submitting your film.
rules.intro: Review the following requirements before submitting through FilmFreeway.

sections.title: Eligibility
body: Narrative, documentary, animation, experimental, and hybrid films may be submitted when the submitter has authority to enter the work.
items: Submit to either the short or feature division according to runtime
Incomplete or inaccessible screeners may be ruled ineligible
False or materially misleading entry data may result in disqualification

sections.title: Runtime divisions
body: Runtime includes credits. Exactly 35:00 belongs to the short division; 35:01 and longer belongs to the feature division.

sections.title: Rights and permissions
body: The submitter is responsible for music, performance, archive, trademark, and other rights required for review and any authorized winner promotion.

sections.title: Language and subtitles
body: Films with dialogue not primarily in English must provide readable English subtitles unless the work is intentionally non-verbal.

sections.title: Selection and final decisions
body: Eligible films are considered for each award against the published evaluation criteria.

sections.title: Fees and refunds
body: Submission fees are non-refundable except when the event is cancelled by the organizer or due to a natural disaster.

sections.title: Withdrawal and corrections
body: Requests must include the FilmFreeway submission identifier and come from the registered contact address. Withdrawal does not automatically create a refund right.

selection.title: A five-stage selection process from entry to announcement.
selection.intro: Every film is reviewed against the published eligibility requirements and evaluation criteria.

sections.title: 1. Intake and eligibility
body: Runtime, screener access, entry details, required rights, and subtitles are checked.

sections.title: 2. Award-criteria review
body: Each film is considered against the criteria relevant to direction, writing, cinematography, performance, production, and the other awards.

sections.title: 3. Finalist selection
body: Award candidates are selected from each division and advanced to the final round.

sections.title: 4. Final selection
body: The shortlisted films are considered again before the winner of each award is selected.

sections.title: 5. Publication and notification
body: Results are announced on the official website at the end of the month, with certificates and laurels provided to winners.

awards.title: Nine categories in each runtime division.
awards.intro: Short and feature divisions use the same award structure. A film may receive more than one award.

sections.title: Award categories
body: The following nine awards are offered in both the short and feature divisions.

sections.title: Allocation rule
body: When a division has at least one eligible submission, one winner is selected for each category. Only a division with zero eligible submissions is marked no award.
items: One film may receive multiple awards
Each award is selected on the merits of the submitted films
No award may be given when there is no eligible work

sections.title: Digital certificate
body: Confirmed winners receive a PDF certificate with a unique certificate identifier that can be checked on the verification page.

sections.title: Official laurels
body: Confirmed winners receive an editable SVG laurel and a transparent PNG export.

winners.title: Award
winners.intro: Award results and past winning films are published here.

sections.title: Latest cycle
body: There is no published cycle yet.

sections.title: Monthly archive
body: View past award-winning films here.

faq.title: Answers about submission, review, and results.
faq.intro: Information about eligibility, selection, award results, and certificates.

sections.title: Is this an in-person festival?
body: At launch, results are published online and no public venue screening is announced.

sections.title: How are films selected?
body: After eligibility is checked, films are considered against the published evaluation criteria.

sections.title: Which division applies at exactly 35 minutes?
body: A runtime of 35:00 belongs to the short division. Any runtime above 35:00 belongs to the feature division.

sections.title: Can one film receive multiple awards?
body: Yes. The same film may receive more than one award.

sections.title: When are results published?
body: Results are scheduled for 12:00 JST on the last day of the month.

sections.title: How are certificates verified?
body: Use the unique certificate identifier on the verification page. The public record does not expose private submission data.

sections.title: What is the refund policy?
body: Submission fees are non-refundable except when the event is cancelled by the organizer or due to a natural disaster.

contact.title: Contact us about submissions or award results.
contact.intro: Do not send screeners, passwords, identity documents, payment card data, or other unnecessary sensitive information through this form.

sections.title: What to include
body: Include your name, email, topic, message, and FilmFreeway submission identifier when the inquiry concerns an entry.

sections.title: Response process
body: A receipt email is sent after submission. We review each inquiry and reply in turn.

sections.title: Privacy
body: Inquiry information is used only to respond to your request and meet applicable legal obligations.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: How information collected through submissions and inquiries is handled.

sections.title: Information collected
body: Submission records, inquiry details, correspondence identifiers, review records, award records, and technical anti-abuse data may be processed.

sections.title: Purpose of use
body: Data is used to administer submissions, answer inquiries, review films, publish award results, issue certificates, prevent abuse, and meet legal obligations.

sections.title: Retention
body: Information is retained only for as long as needed for the stated purposes and applicable legal requirements.

sections.title: Service providers
body: Information may be shared with service providers used for submissions, email, website operation, and abuse prevention only to the extent needed for those purposes.

sections.title: Questions and requests
body: Use the contact route for applicable access, correction, deletion, or objection requests. Identity may need to be verified before a request is completed.

terms.title: Website and participation terms
terms.intro: The basic terms that apply to use of this website and film submissions.

sections.title: Website use
body: Users must not interfere with the site, attempt unauthorized access, submit malicious content, or misrepresent affiliation with the program.

sections.title: Submissions
body: Film entries are governed by the published rules and the confirmed FilmFreeway listing. The submitter is responsible for accurate data and required rights.

sections.title: Decisions and corrections
body: Clerical or factual errors may be corrected. Affected participants will be contacted when appropriate.

sections.title: Fees and refunds
body: Submission fees are non-refundable except when the event is cancelled by the organizer or due to a natural disaster.

sections.title: Schedule and program changes
body: Dates or program details may change due to natural disasters, communications failures, or other unavoidable circumstances. Material changes will be announced on the official website.

accessibility.title: A site designed for keyboard, screen reader, and zoom use.
accessibility.intro: If you encounter a barrier while using the site, please let us know through the contact route.

sections.title: Commitment
body: We aim to keep content perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust across modern devices and assistive technologies.

sections.title: Measures
body: The site supports semantic headings, visible keyboard focus, image alternatives, sufficient contrast, responsive layouts, and reduced motion.

sections.title: Report a barrier
body: Use the contact form and select accessibility. Describe the page, task, device, browser, and assistive technology when possible.

verify.title: Check a published certificate identifier.
verify.intro: Verification confirms only the public award record associated with the identifier. It does not expose submission or review data.

sections.title: Enter the certificate ID
body: Use the exact identifier printed on the PDF certificate.

sections.title: Verification result
body: A confirmed record displays the cycle, division, award, film title, credited recipient, issue date, and current certificate status.
